segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that entereth not by the door into the sheepfold, but climbeth up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: But he that entereth in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: To him the porter openeth; and the sheep hear his voice: and he calleth his own sheep by name, and leadeth them out.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And when he putteth forth his own sheep, he goeth before them, and the sheep follow him: for they know his voice.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And a stranger will they not follow, but will flee from him: for they know not the voice of strangers.
This parable spake Jesus unto them: but they understood not what things they were which he spake unto them.
Then said Jesus unto them again,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, I am the door of the sheep.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: All that ever came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: But he that is an hireling, and not the shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, seeth the wolf coming, and leaveth the sheep, and fleeth: and the wolf catcheth them, and scattereth the sheep.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: The hireling fleeth, because he is an hireling, and careth not for the sheep.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: I am the good shepherd, and know my sheep, and am known of mine.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: As the Father knoweth me, even so know I the Father: and I lay down my life for the sheep.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, and one shepherd.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Therefore doth my Father love me, because I lay down my life, that I might take it again.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: No man taketh it from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. This commandment have I received of my Father.
¶ There was a division therefore again among the Jews for these sayings.
And many of them said,

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: He hath a devil, and is mad; why hear ye him?
Others said,

segments.speaker: others
segments.text: These are not the words of him that hath a devil. Can a devil open the eyes of the blind?
¶ And it was at Jerusalem the feast of the dedication, and it was winter.
And Jesus walked in the temple in Solomon’s porch.
Then came the Jews round about him, and said unto him,

segments.speaker: Jews
segments.text: How long dost thou make us to doubt? If thou be the Christ, tell us plainly.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Jesus answered them,
I told you, and ye believed not:

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: the works that I do in my Father’s name, they bear witness of me.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: But ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep, as I said unto you.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: My Father, which gave them me, is greater than all; and no man is able to pluck them out of my Father’s hand.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: I and my Father are one.
Then the Jews took up stones again to stone him.
Jesus answered them,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Many good works have I shewed you from my Father; for which of those works do ye stone me?

segments.speaker: Jews
segments.text: The Jews answered him, saying,
For a good work we stone thee not; but for blasphemy;

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: and because that thou, being a man, makest thyself God.
Jesus answered them,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Is it not written in your law, I said, Ye are gods?

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: If he called them gods, unto whom the word of God came, and the scripture cannot be broken;

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Say ye of him, whom the Father hath sanctified, and sent into the world, Thou blasphemest; because I said, I am the Son of God?

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: But if I do, though ye believe not me, believe the works: that ye may know, and believe, that the Father is in me, and I in him.
Therefore they sought again to take him: but he escaped out of their hand,
And went away again beyond Jordan into the place where John at first baptized; and there he abode.
And many resorted unto him, and said,

segments.speaker: Many came to Him and
segments.text: John did no miracle: but all things that John spake of this man were true.
And many believed on him there.
